events.text: March Council and reed-clan delegates meet. River-rights tension is manageable; their decisions are not controlled by the player.

SCENE: Maddoc returned to the Maddren homestead at 18:51 on 30 Seedwake 1156 AC. Hedra and Nessa are at home preparing supper and ask about his day. At Mossgate he ate windfall apples with Tessa and Bram, then made a four-hour Soul self-awareness practice attempt (d20 6+2=8 vs DC14): failure, no progress; stamina 34/36. He has studied introductory Meridian, Arcane and Soul theory, has no awakened discipline, and intends to meet his friends tomorrow.
